summary: Tested backend (12 pytest cases across /api/, /api/dashboard, /api/projects, /api/projects/{id}, PATCH field) and all 5 flagship frontend screens end-to-end via Playwright on the public URL. Hero project RTF-2026-0142 flows all work: dashboard KPIs (42/8/3/47min), 8 project rows, project overview (readiness ring 82%, property diagram + element detail, readiness breakdown, 3 items before issue, existing construction), design workspace (left nav, 3 measure cards, EWI detail with 5-row wall build-up, calculated U 0.28 with PASS, junction manager 4/6 resolved), junction resolve -> status update + 'Window Reveal detail resolved' toast persisted via PATCH, focus mode hides nav, theme toggle sets html.dark, command palette via button and Ctrl+K navigating to selected project, and multi-page typeset Design Pack. One CRITICAL crash found: 6 of the 8 seeded projects have no property/measures/readiness/designPack data, so ProjectOverview, DesignWorkspace and DesignPack all white-screen for them.

minor.issue: Empty path ({"path": "", "value": "x"}) returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 400/422. No validation on `path` (min_length / allowed-prefix). Arbitrary dotted paths can also overwrite any field incl. id/ref — no allow-list.
Stats are partially hardcoded (activeProjects=42, avgDesignTime=47, max(...,8)/max(...,3)) rather than derived from data — acceptable for demo but will not reflect real data changes.

ui_bugs.issue: White screen crash for the 6 'light' seeded projects (RTF-2026-0151, 0149, 0147, 0144, 0140, 0136). PageError: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'elements')" at ProjectOverview (p.property.elements) and "...reading 'map'" on the pack route. 6 of 8 dashboard rows are therefore dead ends. Fix: seed property/measures/readiness/itemsBeforeIssue/designPack for all projects, or add optional-chaining + graceful empty state.
KPI tiles have no data-testid, so stat values cannot be asserted robustly (had to fall back to text scraping).
Radix console error on every open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible' — add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle.

issues: Large empty vertical gap (~450px) between the title block and the cover photograph; cover page feels unbalanced at 1920x1080.
designPack.photos and drawings are empty arrays in seed data, so photo schedule / drawing register sections render empty for this project.

action_items: CRITICAL: prevent white-screen for the 6 light projects — seed full property/measures/readiness/designPack or guard with optional chaining + empty state on ProjectOverview, DesignWorkspace, DesignPack.
Validate `path` in PATCH /api/projects/{id}/field (reject empty/unknown paths with 400/422; restrict to an allow-list) instead of 500.
Add data-testid to Dashboard KPI values (e.g. kpi-active-projects).
Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to the command palette dialog.
Tighten Design Pack cover page vertical rhythm; populate designPack for non-hero projects.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectOverview.jsx L31 dereferences p.property.elements with no guard — any project document lacking `property` crashes the route (real for 6 of 8 seeded docs).
server.py PATCH endpoint passes user-supplied `path` straight into a Mongo $set — unvalidated field-path injection and 500 on empty string.
DesignWorkspace.jsx is 599 lines; consider splitting the measure detail / junction manager into separate components.
seed_data_creation: None created; used auto-seeded projects. PATCH tests restored original values (designStage, measures.0.junctions.2.status back to 'warn').
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py). All hero-project (RTF-2026-0142) UI flows verified working including junction resolve persistence, focus mode, theme, command palette, design pack. Retest the 6 light projects (RTF-2026-0151/0149/0147/0144/0140/0136) on /project/{id}, /project/{id}/design/overview and /project/{id}/pack after the fix, plus the empty-path PATCH validation test.
rca_of_the_issue: LIGHT_PROJECTS in server.py are seeded with only summary fields (no property/measures/readiness/itemsBeforeIssue/designPack). GET /api/projects/{id} returns those partial docs, and ProjectOverview/DesignWorkspace/DesignPack assume the hero-shaped schema, so React throws TypeError during render and the whole route white-screens. Reproduce: open '/' and click any project row other than 12 Oak Street or 1 Marion Roberts Court.
